test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

As the storm raged outside, the children huddled together under blankets, listening to the sound of the rain __hitting the windows hard__ and hoping that the power wouldn't go out.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **pounding against the windows**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pounding"** means hitting or striking something with great force or repeatedly. (पीटने या प्रहार करने की क्रिया)

 
 
• **Example: **She could hear her heart pounding as the exam results were announced.
 
 
 
• **"Pounding against the windows"** implies that the rain was hitting the windows with significant force. (खिड़कियों पर जोर से मारना)
 
 
• **Example: **The wind was so strong that the branches were pounding against the windows all night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **pounding against the windows**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Climbing up to the windows **(खिड़कियों की ओर चढ़ना): Ascending towards the windows.

 
 
• **Example: **The cat was climbing up to the windows to watch the birds outside.
 
 
 
• **Setting off the windows** (खिड़कियों से निकलना): Triggering movement away from the windows.
 
 
• **Example: **He was setting off the windows to start his morning run.
 
 
 
• **Beating off the windows** (खिड़कियों से बाहर मारना): Striking away from the windows.
 
 
• **Example:** They heard the sound of rain beating off the windows during the night.
